Reasoning: This release stage is represented as keeping the panda_fingertip pose fixed while opening the gripper. freeze_position enforces the current fingertip origin position within the specified 0.01 m tolerance, and freeze_orientation enforces the current fingertip orientation within the specified 0.05 rad tolerance without adding any new tool-axis relation. open_gripper commands the symmetric gripper opening and provides the gripper-opened success condition. The API has no direct term for gripper finger contact/effort dropping to free-space levels, proving cube_1 is no longer grasped, or verifying cube_1 remains stably supported on cube_2 without slip, so those monitored release/stability clauses are omitted from the constraint list.
